name: Compose AI
tagline: Compose AI is a Chrome extension that adds AI autocomplete to any text field on the web — email, Notion, Google Docs, LinkedIn, and more. It learns your writing style over time and offers inline completions, rephrase suggestions, and email reply drafts without switching apps.
